description.en: Original Joffrea-inspired attached reproductive-shoot specimen only: long/short-shoot junction with several naturally stalked elongate follicles, all represented in one mature twisted-infructescence teaching state supported at abstract/caption level. Shallow geometric follicle sutures, nominal18cm span, count, color and relief are artistic. No whole parent/tree crown, unassociated leaves, loose seeds, seedlings or mixed maturity states added; unrelated inherited Onoclea source is not a diagnostic Joffrea fruit proof.
description.zh: 原创Joffrea启发附果枝标本：长短枝交界与数枚自然果柄相接的长蓇葖，统一采用摘要/图注可支持的成熟扭曲果序教学阶段。几何浅缝、名义18厘米、数量配色与起伏属美术；无整株树冠/未关联叶/散落种子/幼苗/混成熟态，继承Onoclea来源不当作Joffrea果形专证。
